gaps.quote: Let $P_s$ be the permutation of length-$s$ vectors that reorders their entries by multiplying each position by $t$ modulo $s$
gaps.note: Multiplying positions by t modulo s is a bijection only when t and s have no common factor. The page never states or justifies this, so the reader cannot check that P_s is a permutation.
